name: iwantmyname
description: Check domain name availability and get a link to any available domain on iwantmyname.

interface.longDescription:
Check whether a domain name is available, live from iwantmyname's domain search, and get a link to any domain that's free. Use it to find a domain name for your business, online store, website or project without leaving the chat.

What you can do:
• Check if a domain is taken: "Is sunnybakery.com available?"
• Compare extensions for one name, such as .com, .net and .org
• Brainstorm business or brand names, then check the whole shortlist at once
• Check international names such as café.de

Every domain gets a clear answer: available, taken, or couldn't be checked right now. Available domains come with a Continue link that opens the domain on iwantmyname.

Private and read-only: no account or sign-up, only the domain names you ask about are sent, and nothing is saved or linked to you. It never changes, transfers or orders a domain for you; anything further happens on iwantmyname.com, by you. Availability changes all the time, so check again just before you go ahead.
defaultPrompt: Suggest 5 names for a coffee shop and check which .com domains are free

positive.description: A single well-known domain that is already taken.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls domain_availability_check once with google.com and says it is taken. No link is shown for it.

positive.description: Several domains checked together in one request.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls domain_availability_check once with all three domains and reports each one as taken, one answer per domain.

positive.description: Domains nobody holds yet, which come back available with a link.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls domain_availability_check once with both domains, says both are available, and gives a Continue link for each that opens that domain on iwantmyname. Suggests checking again just before going ahead.

positive.description: Brainstorming names, then checking the shortlist.
positive.prompt: Suggest 3 names for a coffee shop and check which .com domains are free
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests three names, calls domain_availability_check once with the three .com domains, and reports each as available or taken, with a Continue link for each available one.
Calls domain_availability_check with café.de and says it is taken, showing the name as café.de (xn--caf-dma.de).

negative.description: Asks the plugin to buy a domain on the user's behalf. It only checks availability, so it does not claim to have bought or reserved anything; it may check the name and offer the Continue link so the user carries on at iwantmyname.com.
Asks to transfer a domain. The plugin is read-only and cannot transfer, delete or change domains, so it should say so and not claim the action was done.
negative.prompt: Transfer my domain example.com to another provider

negative.description: An unrelated question. The plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Wellington today?
